Writer-process talk: L313 '어느 쪽이 바깥에 놓이는지는 여기서 확정하지 않았습니다' (better: '공식 문서는 이 순서를 밝히지 않습니다'); L284 '이 블록에서는 두 이름의 모듈 경로를 확정하지 않았으므로'. L48 '이 목록은 서드파티 페이지의 설명입니다' is a redundant attribution tail. L77 '...변화라고 부릅니다' has no subject (who calls it that?). L471 '주목하십시오' switches register. L104 '이 설계에서 중요한 점은 ... 방식입니다' is a noun frame.
score_evidence.C: Mostly smooth, and the running example ties the sections together. The name `agent` is reassigned about 8 times (L245, L465, L535, L629, L685, L712, L800, L926), so 'the agent defined above' (L277) is hard to follow. The duplicate heading at L123/L126 breaks the flow.
score_evidence.D: The hard parts get worked numbers: the backoff schedule table L740-747, the limit overshoot at L985 (8,500 -> over 10,000), the event-count table L156-162 and the precedence table L479-483. Some padding: the formula N_model = N_tool + 1 (L92) and the 1+2=3 s sum (L309-311) belabour simple arithmetic.
score_evidence.E: Tables and code are used where they help. The display formulas at L92 and L309-311 are decorative. The ASCII diagrams are fine. There is no real architecture figure for the control layers (hooks, middleware and interventions around the loop), even though that is the post's main idea.
score_evidence.F: In-sample: one wrong attribution (L48) and one unsupported default (L528); details in claims. Out of sample, PLAUSIBLE: L195 advises HookOrder.SDK_FIRST so an audit hook wraps outermost. Per the hooks docs, an explicit order means 'lower values run first' (After events reverse only within one order group), so an SDK_FIRST hook also runs first on After events and does not wrap outermost.
score_evidence.T1: Plenty of real code, but 9 of the 27 Python blocks fail as pasted (executed against strands-agents 1.63.0 with the agent call stubbed). NameErrors come from imports the post leaves out on purpose, although the docs give them: InvokeModelStage, ExecuteToolStage, ModelThrottledException (L279, L323, L352; docs import from strands.middleware and strands.types.exceptions) and InterventionHandler, Deny, Proceed, Transform, Confirm, HumanInTheLoop (L434, L499, L511, L532; docs: strands.interventions, strands.vended_interventions.hitl). The block at L619 also omits 'from agent_control.integrations.strands import ...' and 'from strands.models.openai import OpenAIModel', which the Agent Control blog prints, and fails on import until agent-control-sdk is installed. The MCP block at L706 imports streamablehttp_client, which mcp 2.3.0 (pulled by the current SDK) renamed to streamable_http_client, so it raises ImportError. The post also hedges on the invocation_state argument names (L172), which the hooks docs show as agent(..., user_id=...).
score_evidence.T2: Covers the source pages in a sensible order (agent loop, hooks, hook events, middleware, interventions, HITL, steering, lifecycle controls, retry, conversation management, structured output, AgentCore deploy) and does not pad with sections the sources do not support.
score_evidence.T3: Strong internals: hooks vs middleware vs interventions, last-write-wins vs typed precedence, and the semantics of limits checked at turn boundaries. Integration is covered: AgentCore /ping and /invocations, OTel baggage session.id, the eval pipeline, and Graph or AgentCore Policy when determinism is needed. Design advice reads as recommendation.

details.evidence: No image links at all. The agent-loop diagram is an inline text block (L64-75), so there is no remote docs host image.
There is no shared-module-agent-in-async-handler warning. L1042 only restates the docs ('이미 실행 중인 에이전트를 다시 호출하면 ConcurrencyException'), and sync-vs-invoke_async blocking is never discussed.

The per-request agent pattern (L1054) is justified only by the concurrency guard and the retry-strategy sharing rule. The post never says a shared agent carries one request's conversation into the next, and invoke_async appears only in the idempotency sentence (L1044).
AgentResult use shows stop_reason (L546, L1073), interrupts and structured_output. result.metrics.get_summary() never appears (grep 'metrics' finds nothing).
There is no '최소 실행 단위 ... 정보를 주고받으며' sentence; multi-agent appears only as hook events (L168) and Graph (L1164).
